missing_information.channel: Let X=m_Z+epsilon with arbitrary centered latent mean m_Z, covariance Delta, epsilon~N(0,S_0), and S_*=S_0+Delta; assume S_0,S_*,Delta,Omega commute and S_0>0.
missing_information.score_identity: For component, output and matched-Gaussian relative scores u_Z,u,u_*, one has u_Z-u_*=S_0^(-1)m_Z+(S_*^(-1)-S_0^(-1))X and u-u_*=E[u_Z-u_*|X].
missing_information.k1648_conversion: In K1648's real sine/cosine convention, including the universal quarter, R_(Omega,N)/4=C_(F,N)-M_(F,N) with 0<=M_(F,N)<=C_(F,N).
missing_information.scope_guard: This is the continuous equal-covariance specialization of K1606's score-variance mechanism, not a new finite-mixture theorem and not a posterior localization bound by itself.
